features: two orthogonal flat plates of equal thickness; two aligned circular through holes on each plate
unknowns: all dimensions and hole centers must be measured
completion: unobserved back surfaces and input damage restoration are template prior, never measurements
foreground: first prototype supports textured saturated purple material; other colors need user-provided foreground masks
